title: Remove selected elements, smooth layout, and add visible Terms & Policy link

requirements.summary: Remove the scroll-to-top button and anchor wrapper from the page layout
acceptanceCriteria: The scroll-to-top button/anchor is no longer rendered anywhere on the page
No broken layout or empty space left where the button was

file_operations.description: Remove the scroll-to-top button SVG icon and its anchor wrapper element that appears as a floating element in the main layout (div[3]/a[1]). Ensure no empty containers or positioning artifacts remain after removal.

requirements.summary: Remove paragraph and button elements from section 4 and adjust layout smoothly
acceptanceCriteria: The paragraph and button in section 4's third column/card are no longer rendered
Section 4 layout adjusts gracefully with no orphaned empty containers or awkward spacing

file_operations.description: Remove the paragraph element and button element from the third card/column in the services grid (section 4). Adjust the grid layout and card structure to ensure remaining service cards are evenly distributed without gaps or layout breaks on mobile and desktop viewports.

requirements.summary: Remove the logo text div from the header while keeping the logo image intact
acceptanceCriteria: The header logo text div is no longer visible
The header logo icon/image remains visible and the header layout stays balanced

file_operations.description: Remove the text label div (div[2]) that appears next to the logo image in the header anchor element. Keep the logo image/icon intact and ensure the header layout remains balanced and properly aligned after the text removal.

requirements.summary: Remove the third card container from section 7 and adjust grid layout
acceptanceCriteria: The third card/div in section 7's second row/column group is removed
Remaining cards in section 7 are evenly distributed without empty gaps
No layout breakage on mobile or desktop

file_operations.description: Remove the entire third card/container div (div[3]) including its inner content div and anchor link from the ContactSection grid layout. Adjust the parent grid or flex container so remaining contact cards fill the space evenly on both mobile and desktop viewports without gaps or layout breaks.

requirements.summary: Add a clearly visible Terms & Policy link in the website footer
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Terms & Policy' link is visible in the footer
The link is styled consistently with other footer navigation links
The link is visible on both mobile and desktop viewports

file_operations.description: Add a 'Terms & Policy' navigation link in the footer's navigation links area alongside existing footer links. The link should navigate to /terms and be styled consistently with other footer navigation links. Ensure visibility and proper spacing on both mobile and desktop viewports.
